verdict.rationale: Official SDK support is documented: the CDP SDK ships x402 building blocks that enable Bazaar automatically, there are TypeScript SDK functions for discovery, a CDP SDK buyer flow and a generated OpenAPI client. A runtime probe confirms the x402 protocol SDK is on npm (1.2.0, published by the x402 Foundation with SLSA provenance). Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond TypeScript/npm (e.g. Python or Go), in-depth SDK API reference documentation, independent hands-on reports of building with the SDKs.
